title: Look Less, Hear Better: Jointly Rewarded GRPO for Streaming ASR
abstract: arXiv:2609.18333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) must be judged jointly on what it transcribes and on how quickly it commits each word. Delayed streams modeling (DSM) has become the dominant paradigm for streaming large audio-language models, exposing a structural delay $\tau$ that bounds the decoder's lookahead. We show that $\tau$ is a poor proxy for user-perceived latency, and that the alignment-based supervision of DSM leaves latency on the table: the same forced-aligned transcript is used at every $\tau$, forcing the model to withhold words it could already commit. We introduce AWED, a word-level emission-delay metric defined relative to the acoustic end of each word, and post-train a DSM recognizer with GRPO under a reward that scores transcription accuracy and measured delay jointly. Trained at a single operating point ($\tau=6$ frames), our model dominates both its supervised fine-tuning initialization and the Voxtral Realtime back

translated_title: 看得更少，听得更好：用于流式语音识别的联合奖励GRPO
translated_abstract: 流式自动语音识别（ASR）必须从两个方面同时进行评估：转录的内容是什么，以及每个单词被提交输出的速度有多快。延迟流建模（DSM）已成为流式大音频语言模型的主导范式，它暴露出一个结构性延迟参数 $\tau$，该参数限制了解码器的前瞻量。我们证明 $\tau$ 是用户感知延迟的一个糟糕的代理指标，并且DSM基于对齐的监督方法未能充分优化延迟：同一段强制对齐的转录文本在每个 $\tau$ 值下都被使用，迫使模型扣留那些它本可以立即输出的单词。我们提出了AWED，一个相对于每个单词声学结束时刻定义的词级输出延迟指标，并在同时评分转录准确度和测量延迟的联合奖励下，使用GRPO对DSM识别器进行后训练。仅在单一操作点（$\tau=6$ 帧）训练后，我们的模型在其监督微调初始模型和Voxtral Realtime基线之上均取得优势……
tldr: 该论文提出AWED词级输出延迟指标，并通过GRPO联合奖励同时优化转录准确率与实际单词输出延迟，使流式语音识别在单一操作点训练下显著超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AWED, a word-level emission-delay metric, and applies GRPO with a joint reward to optimize both transcription accuracy and measured emission latency, enabling streaming ASR trained at a single operating point to outperform existing baselines.
